root_text:
@ARadicalShift @outbreakupdates HMPV isn’t new, it just doesn’t get talked about much in the respiratory soup mix that exists. 

It’s a pretty nasty virus, if you ever had a “bad cold” that knocked you on your ass, it could have been HMPV.
